title: How many bicycles and tricycles make 46 wheels?
description: A stand has twenty cycles, some bicycles and some tricycles, with forty six wheels in all. A letter for the tricycles lets us count the wheels and find six tricycles and fourteen bicycles. Keeko doubts this and divides the wheels by two.
teaching_notes: One idea: let a letter stand for the number of tricycles, write the bicycles as twenty take away that letter, and count the wheels. Watch for students who treat every cycle as having two wheels.

source: A stand has 20 cycles, some bicycles and some tricycles, wit
video_script.why: The child sees how a letter for the unknown count turns a wheel puzzle into an equation that can be solved and checked.
video_script.substitution: Let t be the tricycles, so there are 20 − t bicycles, count the wheels 3t + 2 (20 − t) = 46, solve, and check.
video_script.anchor: a cycle stand with twenty cycles, some with two wheels and some with three, and the total of forty six wheels
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko treats every cycle as a bicycle and divides the forty six wheels by two to get twenty three bicycles, forgetting that tricycles have three wheels.
video_script.payoff_line: There are six tricycles and fourteen bicycles
maths_rules: 20 cycles in all; let t be the tricycles, so there are 20 − t bicycles
slip: 46 ÷ 2 = 23 is more than the 20 cycles
video_script.design: One idea: a letter for the tricycles gives the bicycles as twenty take away that letter, and counting wheels gives the equation. The wheel count stays on the board. Keeko's doubt is to divide the wheels by two.

narration: <bookmark mark='tri'/>Step two, count the wheels. Each tricycle has three wheels, so the tricycles have three tee wheels.
<bookmark mark='bi'/>Each bicycle has two wheels, so the bicycles have two times, twenty take away tee.
<bookmark mark='total'/>All the wheels add up to forty six.
<bookmark mark='open'/>Step three, open the bracket. Two times twenty is forty, and two times tee is two tee.
<bookmark mark='join'/>Three tee take away two tee is tee, so tee plus forty is forty six.
<bookmark mark='tee'/>Take forty from forty six, and tee is six.
<bookmark mark='bikes'/>Step four, find the bicycles and check. Twenty take away six is fourteen bicycles.
<bookmark mark='check'/>Three times six is eighteen, and two times fourteen is twenty eight. Together that is forty six wheels.

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks there are twenty three bicycles, because forty six wheels divided by two is twenty three.
<bookmark mark='test'/>But there are only twenty cycles in all, so twenty three is too many.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Tricycles have three wheels, so the wheels cannot be shared out two for each cycle.
